Manaweaving is the art of weaving mana into the air to create magical effects. It is the most basic form of magic, and is the first thing I will learn.

To weave a spell, I must first open the manaweaving UI. I can do this by pressing the 'V' key by default. I can change this key in the controls menu.

Once I have the UI open, I can start weaving a spell. I do this by left-clicking to place a manaweave. I can also right-click to remove a manaweave. I can also use the mouse wheel to cycle through the different manaweave types.

I can also use the '1' through '9' keys to quickly select a manaweave type.

I can also use the 'Tab' key to cycle through the different manaweave types in reverse order.

I can also use the 'Q' key to clear all manaweaves from the current spell.

I can also use the 'E' key to rotate the current spell.

I can also use the 'R' key to flip the current spell.

I can also use the 'F' key to finalize the current spell. Once a spell is finalized, it will be added to my spell inventory.

I can also use the 'G' key to cancel the current spell.

I can also use the 'Z' key to undo the last manaweave I placed.

I can also use the 'X' key to redo the last manaweave I removed.

I can also use the 'C' key to copy the current spell to my spell book.

I can also use the 'V' key to paste the last spell I copied from my spell book.

I can also use the 'B' key to open my spell book.

I can also use the 'N' key to create a new spell.

I can also use the 'M' key to open the manaweaving UI.

There are many different types of manaweaves that I can use to weave spells. Each one has a different effect, and can be combined with other manaweaves to create more complex spells.

The first type of manaweave is the
Straight Manaweave

. This is the most basic type of manaweave, and is used to create a straight line of mana.

The second type of manaweave is the
Curved Manaweave

. This is used to create a curved line of mana.

The third type of manaweave is the
Spiral Manaweave

. This is used to create a spiral of mana.

The fourth type of manaweave is the
Loop Manaweave

. This is used to create a loop of mana.

The fifth type of manaweave is the
Arc Manaweave

. This is used to create an arc of mana.

The sixth type of manaweave is the
Wave Manaweave

. This is used to create a wave of mana.

The seventh type of manaweave is the
Zigzag Manaweave

. This is used to create a zigzag of mana.

The eighth type of manaweave is the
Star Manaweave
. This is used to create a star of mana.

Manaweaves can also have different colors. Each color has a different effect, and can be combined with other colors to create more complex spells.

The first color is
Red

. This color is used to create spells that deal fire damage.

The second color is
Blue

. This color is used to create spells that deal frost damage.

The third color is
Green

. This color is used to create spells that deal nature damage.

The fourth color is
Yellow

. This color is used to create spells that deal lightning damage.

The fifth color is
Purple

. This color is used to create spells that deal arcane damage.

The sixth color is
White

. This color is used to create spells that deal holy damage.

The seventh color is
Black
. This color is used to create spells that deal shadow damage.
